description: This Java class, RequestBodyMapHandlerFactory, provides a factory for obtaining the appropriate RequestBodyMapHandler based on the content type of a ServletRequest and extracting a map from the request body.

classes.name: RequestBodyMapHandlerFactory
classes.description: Factory class that provides RequestBodyMapHandler instances based on request content type.

methods.name: getRequestBodyMapHandler
methods.description: Returns the appropriate RequestBodyMapHandler based on the content type of the server request.

methods.name: extractMapFromRequestBody
methods.description: Extracts a Map from the request body using the appropriate handler.
